title: The Plague Made Workers Rich
sentences: After the Black Death, peasants suddenly had something new: bargaining power.
So many workers had died that there weren't enough hands to farm the land.
Survivors demanded higher wages, and often got them.
In 1351, England passed a law to hold wages at pre-plague levels.
Some historians see this as the beginning of the end of serfdom.
